title: What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

title: stdio
excerpt: In the stdio transport, the client launches the MCP server as a subprocess. Each message is a single JSON RPC request, notification, or response. Messages are delimited by newlines, and MUST NOT contain embedded newlines. excerpt: Roots are a concept in MCP that define the boundaries where servers can operate. They provide a way for clients to inform servers about relevant resources and their locations. What are Roots? A root is a URI that a client suggests a server should focus on. When a client connects to a server, it declares which roots the server should work with. title: Tools

Through tools, LLMs can interact with external systems, perform computations, and take actions in the real world.
